candidates.term: The Horizon inside the Day Gate
candidates.defline: The Horizon lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life always has an opening in it.
candidates.reading: You want a home life with somewhere to go in it, and you are drawn to people whose world is wider than yours. Because your openings come through the people closest to you, love and opportunity arrive together for you more often than for most. From your mid-thirties your home years open wider than any before them, and you will share them with a person whose world is bigger than your own.
candidates.teaser: You are drawn to partners with range, people who open doors you would not find alone. Marriage, for you, is also where opportunity walks in.

domain_readings.Love: In love you are drawn to range: partners with reach, plans, and a suitcase half-packed. Romance for you needs a horizon in it, shared ventures, travel, the next thing planned at breakfast. Choose a partner whose breadth has a center, and the marriage stays an expedition rather than a drift.
domain_readings.Social: Your social world enters through the household: the partner’s people become your people, dinner guests become collaborators, and the address book grows by marriage. Host on purpose. The connected home is one of your chart’s quiet engines, and it runs on invitations.
domain_readings.Wealth: Money moves through your intimate life: opportunities arriving via the partner, ventures shared across the pillow, windfalls with two names on them. It prospers with clean structure, shared goals, separate accounts, written agreements even in love. Romance handles the dreaming. Paperwork keeps the dream funded.

candidates.life_chapter: Your home chapter, the marriage-and-household decades, is where range enters your life: the partner’s world widens yours, and adulthood keeps offering side doors. This era rewards saying yes to shared ventures, and the middle of your life will be its widest part.
candidates.relations: The spouse and the father-line are this seat’s people: a partner with reach, and somewhere behind you a provider whose generosity or absence taught you about open hands. Expect in-laws with doors worth knocking on. Marry the network gladly. Audit it kindly.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the seat wants circulation: accept the invitations for one season and let the household fill.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the open house drains: every guest a venture, every venture a guest. Close the doors one night a week.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, charm at close range turns transactional: affection priced without anyone naming it.
candidates.health_line: Vitality here moves with novelty: stagnation dulls you in mood first, then in the body. Keep moving, keep traveling, and the engine stays young.

Love.headline: You fall for people who widen your life.
Love.recognition: You fall for people who widen your life, the one with plans and friends and somewhere to be. Because range is what draws you, you lose interest within months in a partner who only offers closeness. What you want is someone who brings the world home, and you grow restless with anyone who shuts it out.
Love.lived: The people you have fallen for so far each came with a world attached, a circle of friends or a plan to move or a family that took you in. More than once you have stayed a little longer for the life around someone than for the person.
Love.ahead: Your Home Chapter opens in your mid-thirties, and it is when love and money start to move together. You build a home in these years with someone who brings an opening into your life, and you stay for as long as the two of you keep heading somewhere together.

Social.headline: Your friends come with plans.
Social.recognition: You collect friends who are going somewhere, the ones with a trip planned and a contact for everything. Because range is what draws you, you lose touch with friends whose lives stay small, and you feel guilty about it only later. You know a great many people, and you let only a few of them close.
Social.lived: Most of your friendships so far started with an introduction or an invitation, someone who brought you into their circle. You have kept some of those circles longer than you kept the people who brought you in.
Social.ahead: From your mid-thirties your circle widens through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape your next twenty years through someone you share a home with.

Wealth.headline: Your money comes through the people close to you.
Wealth.recognition: You find money through other people, in a tip from a friend or a side venture with someone close. Because your openings arrive through people you trust, you say yes before you read the terms, and you earn in bursts more than in a steady line. The money you make fastest is the money you hold on to least.
Wealth.lived: Your best money moments so far came through someone else, a tip or a job offer or a deal brought to you by a friend. You lost money the same way, by saying yes before you had read the terms.
Wealth.ahead: From your mid-thirties your income starts to rise through the life you share with a partner, through a joint venture, a move or an opening from their side. You will earn more in these years than in all the years before, and you keep only what has both names written down.

$provenance.replaced: This position rules Love, Social, and Wealth, and it works from your marriage palace. The Horizon lives inside your Day Gate: at close range you are drawn to people with reach, partners who know somebody everywhere and see openings you would walk past. The adult chapters of your life gain range through the one beside you: introductions, ventures, money that moves because the household is connected. Your home tends toward open doors and full calendars, and your fortune likes it that way. The watch-point is scatter. Choose a partner whose breadth comes with a center, and anchor the shared accounts somewhere steady. Then let the doors keep opening. They are your weather.
